title: SSCI Conference (2024)
organization: IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (SSCI)
description: Worked on improving current state-of-the-art prediction systems for Glaucoma Detection and Diagnosis. The system was trained on a large dataset of Glaucoma images and was able to accurately detect and diagnose the presence of glucocorticoid receptors in the images. The system was also able to classify the severity of the glucocorticoid receptor presence in the images, which was crucial for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.

title: ISDCS Conference (2025)
organization: Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology, Shibpur with Hiroshima University, Japan
description: We made an AI powered IOT application that can be used to monitor the temperature, humidity, air quality and multiple other factors both indoor and outdoor. The application was developed using Raspberry Pi and Python. The application was also tested in a real-world scenario and the data was sent to a server for advanced analysis and sent back for indication.
